blockingIssues.description: The only structural regression assertion still runs against the signed-out `audit: null` shell, so the account-shell suite never renders the populated delivery and closeout audit cards from the original routed `/account` validation evidence and leaves the real audited path unguarded.

The populated Linear audit coverage still checks text content without asserting `dl`/`dt`/`dd` semantics, so invalid description-list markup inside `DeliveryAuditCard` or `CloseoutAuditCard` would still pass the populated-audit test.
